notes: «وقال معاذ حدثنا شعبة» names Mu'adh bare; the lexicon's identification as the Companion cannot narrate from شعبة, so it is not adopted (see fix).
«سمع أبا سعيد، رجلا من أصحاب النبي» is read as Abu Sa'id narrating from an unnamed Companion; the Companion is not named in the text.
«بهذا» and the closing «وقال هي ...» (the saying) are not chain links.

fixes.reason: The chain's Mu'adh narrates from Shu'ba (d. 160 AH), so he cannot be the Companion Mu'adh ibn Jabal, who died in 18 AH.

evidence.quote: معاذ بن جبل بن عمرو بن أوس
